name: chronoflow
description: Todo app and time tracker with Jira integration

scripts.dev: concurrently -k --handle-input -n main,renderer "npm run dev:main" "npm run dev:renderer"
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
### ChronoFlow v0.1.10

#### New Features:
- **Jira OAuth auto-save:** after authorizing in the browser, the connection is now saved automatically when your account has a single Jira site — no more missed "Save Connection" step that made the connection seem to disappear when navigating away.

#### Fixes:
- **Jira OAuth callback freeze:** the chronoflow:// callback could spawn a second app instance that hung on the locked database, freezing the app and preventing the connection from ever being saved. A heartbeat guard now makes duplicate instances exit immediately and hands the deep link to the running instance.
- **Database hang protection:** DB initialization now uses a busy timeout and exits cleanly instead of hanging on a locked database.
- **Visible save errors:** Jira connection save failures are now shown in the settings form and logged, instead of failing silently.
